articles.title: ¿Cómo funciona el mercado de criptomonedas y cuál es su valor este lunes 19 de octubre?
articles.text:
Las criptomonedas son un activo digital innovador que han experimentado un crecimiento monumental en los últimos tiempos debido a varios elementos que contribuyen a ello, entre ellos que algunos gobiernos hayan decidido darles una oportunidad como moneda de curso legal; no obstante, también han sufrido descalabros que han puesto en duda su viabilidad, como el más reciente episodio conocido como el "criptoinvierno".
Pese a este panorama, cada vez más personas han empezado a adquirir criptomonedas para poder invertir en algo "seguro" y "fiable" tanto a corto como a largo plazo, a pesar de los niveles extremos de inestabilidad que sufre constantemente.
Sin embargo, invertir o comprar en criptodivisas es más fácil de lo que parece. Hay que recordar que se trata de monedas virtuales, por lo que serán controladas en carteras o monederos que comparten esa particularidad, pues a diferencia del dinero corriente, no tienen un soporte físico.
El precio de las criptomonedas hoy
Esta es la cotización de las criptodivisas más destacadas en este momento.
El Bitcoin, cotiza a 82.773,57 dólares, lo que implicó un cambio de 0,922% en las últimas horas.
La segunda criptomoneda más popular del mercado, Ethereum, ha mostrado un movimiento de 0,929% en las últimas 24 horas, por lo que su valor se ubica en 2.431,12 dólares.
En el caso de TetherUs, su precio es de 1 dólares, por lo que en el último día tuvo un movimiento de 0,02%.
Por su parte, BNB, tiene un valor de 726,85 dólares, con un cambio de 1,37%, en cambio el Litecoin cotizó a 59.873 dólares, tras una variación de 1.8887233.
Finalmente, el Dogecoin, una de las monedas virtuales que fue impulsada por Elon Musk, tiene un valor de 0,08 dólares tras presentar un cambio de 0,68% en las últimas 24 horas.
Qué pasa con las criptodivisas
Luego de que en las primeras semanas de mayo del 2022 se viviera el "criptocrash" o "criptoinvierno" que dejaron al descubierto la enorme volatilidad de estas monedas digitales, ha llegado un nuevo periodo de relativa estabilidad.
Bitcoin, ethereum y BNB han mostrado variaciones "controladas", puesto que no se han disparado los precios como en semanas previas. Por ejemplo, a inicios de agosto, las mencionadas anteriormente tuvieron un cambio menor del 2%.
Por otra parte, algo que esta llamando la atención en el mundo de las criptomonedas es que China está ablandando sus restricciones y podría comenzar a permitir su uso. Específicamente sería Hong Kong en donde este cambio se haría presente.
Sumado a ello, la plataforma de transacciones digitales PayPal anunció su propia stablecoin llamada PayPal USD (PYUSD), que cuenta por el respaldo de depósitos en dólares, bonos del Tesoro de Estados Unidos a corto plazo y activos equivalentes.
La compañía ha afirmado en su declaración que permitirá la transferencia de fondos a monederos digitales de terceros y proporcionará detalles sobre cómo integrar su servicio en exchanges centralizados y descentralizados, con el objetivo de ser utilizado en Finanzas Descentralizadas (DeFi, por sus siglas en inglés). Por lo tanto, es muy probable que se utilice ampliamente en la industria Web3.
Su avance en Latinoamérica
Criptomonedas en México: el Banco de México (Banxico) ha determinado que ninguna de las instituciones que participan en el sistema financiero nacional podrá hacer uso o deberá permitir operaciones de ninguna clase a través de este medio de pago.
En territorio mexicano el empresario Ricardo Salinas Pliego, uno de los más ricos del país, ha mostrado interés en las criptomonedas y ha asegurado que varios de sus negocios aceptarán bitcoin en el futuro, incluido su banco; hasta el momento una de sus tiendas más populares ya lo hace.
Criptomonedas en Perú: el Banco Central de Reserva del Perú (BCR) ha dejado en claro que su misión no es ser el primero ni el segundo banco central que regule el uso de las criptomonedas, ello debido a la inestabilidad que las caracteriza. Sin embargo, hace días el presidente del (BCR) aseguró que el BCR trabajaba en un proyecto de moneda digital propia.
Criptomonedas en Colombia: en la nación sudamericana hay más de 500 sitios donde es permitido pagar con criptodivisas. Colombia ocupa el puesto 14 entre 26 países de adopción de criptomonedas, según el informe de Finder.
Criptomonedas en Centroamérica: en el gobierno de El Salvador, el bitcoin, que en septiembre de 2021 se convirtió en moneda de curso legal, ha perdido oficialmente este estatus en este enero del 2025 tras una reforma aprobada por la Asamblea Legislativa del país. Según informó la prensa local, la modificación de la Ley Bitcoin fue impulsada por el gobierno del presidente Nayib Bukele y respaldada por la mayoría oficialista en el órgano legislativo. Este cambio marca el fin de una política que había colocado al país centroamericano en el centro del debate global sobre las criptomonedas.
¿Cómo crear una criptomoneda?
Al momento de crear una criptomoneda es importante primero determinar qué se desea tener: una moneda o un token. La primera usa su propia blockchain, mientras que la segunda se basa en una red preexistente.
De acuerdo con el sitio de Binance, para crear una criptomoneda se necesita de un gran equipo de desarrolladores y expertos; mientras que para el token sí se requieren conocimientos técnicos pero es posible crearlo en minutos a través del uso de otras blockchains como Ethereum o BNB, que son las más populares.
Los costos de creación, el tiempo requerido y el uso de fuerza de trabajo dependerá de si se opta por hacer una moneda virtual o un token. En éste último caso también se puede usar un código establecido para crear tokens o pagar para usar un servicio de creación de monedas.
Es importante saber que antes de crear una criptomoneda se debe considerar su utilidad y estado legal.
En el caso de elegir crear una criptomoneda, entonces se debe elegir una blockchain, posteriormente se debe hacer un plan acorde al funcionamiento y la funcionalidad de la blockchain para diseñar los nodos y la interfaz.

articles.title: EmbeddingGemma 2 Expands beyond Text to Support Code, Images, Video, and Audio
articles.text:
Based on Gemma 4 and released under the Apache 2.0 license, Google's EmbeddingGemma 2 is a compact, open-weight, multimodal embedding model designed to make semantic search and retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) more efficient while optimizing performance for on-device deployment.
Designed to run on consumer hardware such as mobile devices and laptops, EmbeddingGemma 2 delivers low-latency semantic representations for on-device applications, like search, retrieval-augmented generation (RAG), classification, and clustering.
Thanks to its multimodal capabilities, EmbeddingGemma 2 supports a wide range of retrieval tasks, including finding relevant documents, screenshots, and recordings in response to a query, searching source code using natural language, and retrieving video content based on textual descriptions.
EmbeddingGemma 2's key feature, Google says, is its ability to represent text, code, images, video, and audio in a unified 768-dimensional embedding space. This enables developers to build retrieval systems that search across different media types without maintaining separate, incompatible embedding spaces for different media types.
Despite coming from different modalities, the embeddings generated by EmbeddingGemma 2 occupy the same dimensional space and can be compared on their semantic similarity.
The model allows developers to load only the encoders required for their applications, scaling from 270 million parameters for text and code to 740 million for full multimodal support. According to Google, the model "significantly outperforms EmbeddingGemma 1 on code search and technical retrieval, making it ideal for local codebase indexing and agentic code search".
EmbeddingGemma 2 supports Matryoshka Representation Learning (MRL), which allows embeddings to be truncated into shorter, unit-length vectors, reducing storage requirements. For example, storing a million 768-dimensional vectors at bfloat16 precision takes roughly 1.5 GB of memory, while truncating them to 128 dimensions requires just 250 MB, bringing a sixfold reduction. However, this implies a retrieval quality trade-off. Google therefore recommends using truncation only when storage or search speed require it. At 128 dimensions, the model retains approximately 90% of quality with text, but performance drops to around 75% for image, video, and speech retrieval.
Commenting on the announcement, Reddit user Distinct-Target7503 highlighted the model's multimodal capabilities while questioning the extent of its improvements for text-only tasks:
The impressive thing about this one is that it can embedd images and audio in a shared semantic space, but for text only it is not a massive improvement.
Meanwhile, Reddit user Open-Adhesiveness-86 cautioned developers about the importance of using the model correctly:
Two things that bit me on the first embeddinggemma and probably still apply: the task prefixes aren't optional, indexing docs with the query prefix instead of "title: none | text: " noticeably hurt recall. And if you truncate for MRL, slice first then L2-normalize the shorter vector, normalizing at 768 and then cutting gives you off-norm vectors.
EmbeddingGemma was introduced last year with a focus on "offline and privacy-sensitive scenarios, such as searching across personal files locally, running mobile RAG pipelines with Gemma 3n, or building domain-specific chatbots". EmbeddingGemma 2 is available on Hugging Face.

articles.title: Apple dit tout sur la batterie de l'iPhone Duo : l'autonomie sera-t-elle à la hauteur ?
articles.text:
Pas le choix pour Apple : la marque a été forcée de publier sur son site l’étiquette énergétique européenne de son iPhone Duo. Historiquement, on pouvait connaître la capacité de batterie des produits Apple seulement en démontant ces derniers. Pour l’iPhone Duo, c’est plus simple et ça donne une idée de l’autonomie à attendre du premier smartphone pliant d’Apple.
Rien d’alarmant pour la batterie de l’iPhone Duo
L’iPhone Duo est équipé d’une batterie d’une capacité de 4 883 mAh, divisée en deux cellules. Un chiffre évidemment à comparer ave les batteries d’autres smartphones. Par exemple, l’iPhone 18 Pro dispose d’une batterie de 4 288 mAh (en version eSIM : la version SIM notamment vendue en France a une batterie de 4 056 mAh). Quant à l’iPhone 18 Pro Max, il affiche une grosse batterie de 5 567 mAh (5 391 mAh pour la version avec carte SIM). On le voit, l’iPhone Duo n’a pas à rougir sur les étagères des Apple Store.
Qu’en est-il comparé aux autres smartphones pliants similaires ? Le Samsung Galaxy Z Fold 8, sorti récemment, affiche une capacité de 4 800 mAh. Autre smartphone pliant au format passeport, le Xiaomi 18 Fold est vendu avec 6 000 mAh. En bref, c’est assez similaire avec l’iPhone Duo, bien que le modèle de Xiaomi surpasse la concurrence sur ce point.
Pas d’inquiétude non plus sur l’autonomie
Il faudra évidemment attendre les tests de l’iPhone Duo dans la presse pour se faire une idée, mais son endurance devrait être suffisante. En effet, Apple déclare que son iPhone Duo tient 31 heures en lecture vidéo (déplié, contre 44 heures plié). C’est moins bon que l’iPhone 18 Pro (34 heures) ainsi que la version Pro Max (43 heures).
En Europe, Apple doit donner un autre nombre sur l’étiquette énergétique européenne, l’« endurance de la batterie par cycle ». Il s’agit d’un test d’autonomie normalisé avec un scénario d’usage européen. Sur l’iPhone Duo, c’est 51 heures et 30 minutes, contre 52 heures sur l’iPhone 18 Pro et 62 heures sur l’iPhone 18 Pro Max. Le Galaxy Z Fold 8 tient 49 heures et 10 minutes sur ce même test. Si l’on en croit ces chiffres, alors l’iPhone Duo serait un peu plus endurant que son concurrent de chez Samsung. Un comparatif qui sera vérifié par notre test de l’iPhone Duo grâce à notre protocole du 01Lab.
Tout ceci fait penser que l’iPhone Duo devrait permettre de l’utiliser une journée à une journée et demie par cycle de charge. Une autonomie suffisante pour la plupart des usages (écran plié ou déplié) : lecture vidéo, réseaux sociaux, messages, appels, etc. Pour rappel, l’iPhone Duo sortira ce 23 octobre, mais les précommandes sur le site d’Apple ne permettent qu’une livraison à partir du 25 janvier 2027. Il semblerait qu’Apple n’ait pas suffisamment anticipé les stocks de son nouveau smartphone.
 👉🏻 Suivez l’actualité tech en temps réel : ajoutez 01net à vos sources sur Google, et abonnez-vous à notre canal WhatsApp.
Source : iPhoneAddict

articles.title: VSDC Free Video Editor
articles.text:
The program offers rich functionality and yet has a simple and intuitive interface, allowing you to create videos with a bare minimum of efforts.
Features
Non-linear video editor
Our editor is a non-linear tool. This means that unlike in most other editors, where scenes come one after another in a linear sequence and certain order, our software allows objects to be placed in any position on the timeline and have any size. Besides, various parameters, shape and position of objects can change arbitrarily over time.
Visual and audio effects
You can apply various visual and audio effects to your videos to achieve the necessary result. Since the number of available visual effect is very high, they are split into five categories for ease of navigation: color correction, object transformation, object filters, transition effects and special fx.
Blending modes and Instagram-like filters
One more way of changing the look of your video image according to your preferences is color blending. Using a wide array of adjustable parameters, you can attach a unique professional style to your video. Newbies or those, who would like to save time, can benefit from stylish Instagram-like filters applied in one click.
Masking
VSDC Free Video Editor allows for creating different shaped masks for hiding, blurring or highlighting certain elements in your video. You can use it to apply special effects inside or outside the masked area. One of the most common reasons for masking are to blur a face to protect the identity or remove unwanted marks.
Motion tracking
The Motion tracking tool allows for registering and tracking movements of any objects in a video and then assigns the resulted trajectory to other elements – titles, captions, icons, images, masks, and more. With its help, placing a censorship mask on a moving object or making captions follow a selected element in a video becomes easy.
Easy export to social networks
To prepare a video for Facebook, YouTube, Instagram, Twitter and Vimeo without any problems, VSDC Free Video Editor offers you special export profiles which significantly reduce the stress of selecting a suitable format and meeting all the requirements.
Subpixel accuracy
Objects in a scene are positioned with subpixel accuracy, which makes for smooth animation, rotation, transformation and precise relative positioning.
Support of popular formats
Our software supports virtually all video, image and audio formats and codecs. That is why you won't need any additional conversion tools to edit your files, as is often the case with other programs.
4K and HD export
VSDC is currently the only free video editor that allows you to export in a new H265/HEVC codec to maintain the highest quality at a minimum file size which is essential for those often processing 4K and HD files.
Creation of videos for specific multimedia devices
Thanks to a large set of preconfigured profiles, you can easily create videos for most popular multimedia devices, such as DVD players, iPod/iPhone/iPad, PSP, Galaxy, any smartphones and regular phones, Sony PlayStation, Xbox, Zune, Archos, iRiver, Creative Zen, Blackberry, MP4 players and many others.
Working with charts
You can create diagrams of different kinds, including 3D diagrams: Bar, Stacked Bar, Point, Bubble, Line, Scatter Line, Fast Line, Step Line, Spline, Area, Spline Area, Stacked Area, Stacked Spline Area, Range Bar, Gantt, Pie, Pie 3D, Torus 3D, Radar Point, Radar Line, Radar Area, Radar Spline, Radar Spline Area, Funnel, Pyramid, Pyramid 3D, High Low, Candle Stick. These objects can be based on dynamically changing data of different types. Besides, the appearance of diagrams is fully customizable (appearance of charts, coordinate axes, user-defined axes, legends, names of charts and axes, lines, labels and other elements), which will help you tailor them to your specific needs. Integrated color themes make it possible to quickly change the way your charts look.
Video library (to be included in the next program release)
The editor software lets you create your own library of multimedia files with brief or detailed descriptions. This will help you organize your video collection and simplify access to the necessary files.
Video stabilization tool
Footage taken from drones, action cameras or other devices on the go often needs improvement. VSDC Stabilization tool, as your virtual tripod, helps remove jitter or any other shaking effects, caused by camera movement and turn it into a much smoother video image.
YouTube uploader
VSDC Free Video Editor not only provides ready-made profiles for exporting to social networks, but also offers you to upload your video directly to YouTube right from the app without switching windows or tabs.
Built-in DVD burning tool
The editor comes with a DVD burning tool, allowing you to easily burn the results of your work to optical discs.
Video File Converter
The application is designed to quickly convert video files from one format to another. It has some basic features for editing videos: removing unneeded segments, splitting your video into parts, and merging several files into one.
Desktop video capture
The video editor features a desktop video capture utility that saves captured footage to a video file for subsequent processing in the editor.
Video capturing
Another feature of the our editor is the ability to capture video from various video tuners, webcams, IP Ñameras and save the captured footage on your computer in an arbitrary format for subsequent editing.
What's New
VSDC 11.3 expands the editor with AI video and image generation, AI-powered image editing, new Garmin and DJI telemetry data, and major improvements to the Key Editor and scene editing workflow. The update also enhances project recovery, multi-object editing, interface customization, Lens Distortion accuracy and overall stability.
- Added AI-powered content creation tools:
 
  - AI image generation;
  - AI video generation;
  - AI-powered image editing.
- Expanded Garmin and DJI telemetry support:
 
  - Garmin telemetry now supports cadence, heart rate and compass data;
  - DJI telemetry now supports coordinates, speed and altitude.
- Improved the Key Editor for faster keyframe editing:
 
  - added Y-axis auto-scaling;
  - improved zooming and scrolling while changing the scale;
  - added multi-selection and simultaneous editing of multiple keyframes and points.
- Enhanced scene editing and object transformation:
 
  - added orthogonal movement while holding Shift for objects, custom points, FreeShape/Polyline points, service/tracking points and control points;
  - added proportional resizing for transformed objects while holding Shift;
  - added resizing relative to the object center while holding Alt or Alt+Shift.
- Project files now preserve the state of Timeline and Key Editor tabs, making it easier to continue editing after reopening a project.
- Added the ability to copy Basic Effects property values to selected objects by pressing Enter in the input field, improving multi-object editing.
- Improved Windows shutdown handling: VSDC can now create a recovery project when necessary if the computer is turned off while the editor is running.
- Added a dedicated menu command for removing offline media files from projects.
- Added Ribbon customization for a more flexible editing workspace.
- When multiple objects are selected, Basic parameters with different values are now highlighted in green for easier comparison.
- Added the ability to assign custom hotkeys to the compositing and waveform menus.
- Improved the precision of the Lens Distortion effect for more accurate image correction and creative distortion workflows.
- Added object type filtering through the Properties window to simplify navigation in complex projects.
- Minor improvements and bug fixes:
 
  - Fixed an issue where Quick Access Toolbar customization did not work correctly.
  - Fixed an issue where the Quick Access panel in the Telemetry templates window could disappear after restarting the application.
  - Fixed an issue where columns in the Link media window could be deleted without an option to restore them.
  - Improved rendering of curves and shapes on sharp bends.
  - When combining objects into a sprite, applied effects are now transferred to the sprite as well.
  - Improved keyboard shortcut handling.
  - Fixed an issue where block movement could become locked when snapping to the grid at 200% zoom and with negative coordinates.
  - Fixed an issue where a pane could not be dragged between monitors in certain multi-monitor configurations.
  - Fixed Unicode handling in XMP metadata.
  - Other stability improvements and minor fixes.

articles.title: Il négocie un PC d’occasion à 600 $ dans une boutique portugaise : à l’intérieur, une RTX 4070 Ti Super et des composants à la valeur estimée à 2500 $
articles.text:
Il négocie un PC d’occasion à 600 $ dans une boutique portugaise : à l’intérieur, une RTX 4070 Ti Super et des composants à la valeur estimée à 2500 $
Alors que les prix des composants informatiques ne cessent de grimper, un internaute a fait une très belle affaire chez un prêteur sur gages en récupérant un PC pour 600 $, en réalité estimé à plus de 2 500 $.
Nvidia GeForce RTX 5060 Ti 9 Go
Depuis de nombreux mois, les composants clés pour se monter un PC, comme les cartes graphiques et la RAM, se font de plus en plus rares à cause des besoins des centres de données dédiés à l'IA. Résultat, cette pénurie fait fortement augmenter les prix des rares produits disponibles, et les personnes ayant besoin d'une nouvelle machine doivent souvent se tourner vers des solutions de seconde main. C'est le cas d'un utilisateur de reddit qui, fin 2025, a posté une très, très belle opération.
Une belle affaire dans un contexte toujours plus compliqué
C'est chez un prêteur sur gages au Portugal que l'achat a eu lieu. Un PC est alors indiqué en vente pour 750 $, avec possibilité de négocier. C'est ce que fera l'acheteur, repartant avec sa trouvaille pour 600 $. L'étiquette associée indiquant une "grande valeur" ne savait pas à quel point elle avait raison.
    
        Voir la discussion sur Reddit
    
Dans la tour se cachait notamment une carte graphique Zotac, à savoir une Nvidia GeForce 4070 Ti Super. Au moment de l'achat, celle-ci était estimée seule autour de 800 $ sur les marchés de seconde main, soit déjà plus que tout le PC. En termes de performances, celle-ci égale presque une RTX 5070 Ti et permet de jouer confortablement jusqu'en 4K. Aujourd'hui, le prix demandé pour ce GPU est plutôt autour des 1300-1500 €.
	
J'espère que c'est assez bien pour quelques jeux.
Mais ce n'est pas tout, puisque le reste de la machine est loin de la valeur estimée par le prêteur sur gage : un processeur Intel Core i9-14900KS (700 $ au lancement, encore 800 € neuf chez les revendeurs aujourd'hui) et 64 Go (!) de RAM DDR5 6000. Étant donné le prix de la mémoire vive aujourd'hui, et sans prendre en compte le reste des composants non dévoilés (stockage, carte mère...), il s'agit d'une affaire en or encore aujourd'hui.
Fin 2025, le PC était alors estimé autour des 2500 $, bien loin des 750 $ demandés. Les prix ayant continué à grimper en 2026, cette estimation est aujourd'hui obsolète et cet acheteur peut définivement se féliciter de son affaire.

articles.title: Germany’s NEURA Robotics shows no signs of slowing down as it teams up with Austria’s NXAI for physical AI | EU-Startups
articles.text:
Following last week’s announcement that Germany’s NEURA Robotics would be launching its multimodal foundation for physical AI, today the company confirmed that it would be working with Austria’s NXAI on a building block for the memory of cognitive robots.
To this end, the partners are combining NEURA’s Physical AI stack with xLSTM, a recurrent architecture from NXAI that can efficiently maintain and update state over long sequences. Furthermore, NXAI plans to make its own model, based on the xLSTM architecture, available on the Neuraverse platform.
It is set to be available alongside NEURA’s own foundation model, Neuron AI, in future.
“A robot that truly helps in everyday life and in industry must be able to remember,” says David Reger, founder and CEO of NEURA Robotics. “With Neuron AI, we have the foundation. With Neuraverse, we are creating the platform on which other powerful AI approaches can also find their way into robots. Together with Sepp Hochreiter and NXAI, we are expanding this memory capability. Two European strengths, one goal: Physical AI from Europe, together for the world.”
This follows a period of sustained growth for the Metzingen-based robotics unicorn.
As previously reported by EU-Startups, NEURA secured €15 million from InterAlpen Partners in 2023, following a €52 million round earlier that year. By September 2024, the company had reportedly raised €148.67 million in total, before securing a further €120 million Series B in January 2025. At the time, NEURA reported having doubled its workforce to more than 300 employees and increased its revenue tenfold over the preceding year.
This was followed by the announcement of a Series C of up to €1.2 billion in June 2026, and subsequently by acquisitions involving mobile logistics and autonomous cleaning robotics compamy Adlatus Robotics, extending its capabilities and the potential applications of its Neuraverse ecosystem.
“Memory and experience are essential for robots to reliably solve tasks involving many steps,” says Prof. Dr Sepp Hochreiter, founder of NXAI. “xLSTM is built for this; it is fast, memory-efficient and can maintain its state over long sequences. Together with NEURA, we are bringing this strength to Physical AI – from Europe for the world.”
Today’s news brings two companies that already share many touch-points even closer together.
Founded in 2019, Neura develops the technologies that enable intelligent machines to learn, adapt and work side by side with humans in the real world. The company develops cognitive robots that can see, hear, feel and learn, as well as the software, AI and data infrastructure required for their large-scale deployment.
Founded in 2023, NXAI is an Austrian DeepTech company based in Linz that develops solutions for industrial applications. The company’s mission is to translate its own AI research into market-ready products and to bridge the gap between research and industry. Its research focuses on xLSTM models in the fields of time series and robotics.
The planned integration between the two is intended to enable companies to tailor the NXAI model to their own tasks using the Neuraverse toolchain, test it in the NEURA Gyms and deploy it on suitable robots. This will allow customers to utilise different model approaches within the same training and application environment.
Neuron AI remains NEURA’s own multimodal foundation model and will continue to be developed independently. The partnership brings an additional model option to the platform and includes joint research. Companies retain control over their process knowledge and decide for themselves whether to share data and capabilities.
NEURA contributes the Physical AI Stack: its own multimodal foundation models, robotics, sensor technology, real-world training data from the NEURA Gyms, and the platform for industrial deployment. NXAI brings decades of AI research and a fundamentally different approach to recurrent intelligence and memory. Together, the two aim to make capabilities available more quickly.
In the long term, the aim is for robots not only to perform individual tasks, but to build on their experience over time. This aligns with the vision of the Neuraverse and the Robot Skill Economy: skills that robots learn from interacting with the real world, improve upon, and transfer to other machines and environments.

articles.title: Hackers Steal 1.8 Million Records From Nikkei
articles.text:
Japanese media giant Nikkei has disclosed a fresh data breach impacting more than 1.8 million records.
According to the company, best known for major financial publications, including The Nikkei and Financial Times, the incident involved a cloud service it uses for system development.
On the morning of October 7, the hackers used previously compromised credentials to access the cloud service, Nikkei says.
While a total of 1.83 million records were stolen, about 1.68 million included only information that cannot be used to identify an individual, the company says.
Of the remaining records, 150,000 contained names, addresses, email addresses, phone numbers, and dates of birth, and 120,000 contained email addresses.
No credit card information was compromised in the attack, Nikkei says.
The media giant says it revoked the compromised credentials immediately after identifying the data breach and will take additional security measures if necessary.
It has notified regulators and continues to investigate the scope of the incident and the nature of the compromised data.
According to Nikkei, as of October 16, it has found no evidence that the stolen personal information has been misused.
The company also notes that the incident did not result in disruptions or data tampering.
“We deeply apologize for any inconvenience and concern this may have caused to those involved. We will inform you individually if the leakage of personal information is confirmed,” Nikkei said.
The announcement comes less than a year after the company disclosed a data breach stemming from a Slack account hack.

articles.title: Claude Code AI agent caught a crypto miner hiding on a developer’s overheating Mac — XMRig task was hogging ‘about 1175% CPU, roughly 12 cores’ pushing temps to 112 degrees
articles.text:
Claude Code AI agent caught a crypto miner hiding on a developer’s overheating Mac — XMRig task was hogging ‘about 1175% CPU, roughly 12 cores’ pushing temps to 112 degrees
'Explains why my Mac has been running like s**t,' said the afflicted Redditor.
A developer using Claude Code to help build a temperature monitor app got a friendly warning from the coding agent. “Your Mac is running a crypto miner that I didn’t put there,” flagged the helpful agent. “I saw xmrig using about 1175% CPU, roughly 12 cores,” it informed its human master. Perhaps developer and Redditor UntilHEX should have sensed the crypto miner’s presence without AI help, as they admitted the malware’s presence “explains why my Mac has been running like s**t.”
Ironically, the cryptomining malware’s nefarious CPU cycle hogging activity is what may have led to its discovery and demise. Pondering over a screenshot of the Claude Code window, we see that this malware was probably added to the Mac’s startup roster on August 29. It looks like UntilHEX was inspired to develop a Mac temperature monitor app after this infection to track and diagnose why the computer was running so hot.
Claude stepped in after the Redditor was concerned about a dump of the Mac’s raw temperature sensor readings. “They seemed far too high,” commented UntilHEX in the social media post. Indeed, the well-known coding agent pointed out that the CPU was peaking at a very toasty 112 degrees Celsius. It explained this was due to a sustained heavy load, specifically “xmrig using about 1175% CPU, roughly 12 cores.” We don’t know how many cores the Mac being used had, but maybe 12 were all of them.
Claude Code went on to describe how the crypto miner software had hidden itself on the Apple computer and ran at startup. It cautiously decided not to kill or remove anything from the Mac, but offered to clean up the CPU-hogging crypto miner, which was sucking all the power from the Apple Silicon computer. “Can I clean it up now?” Claude inquired. “I’d stop the startup item and the miner, and move the files into a quarantine folder.”
Later in the comments, UntilHEX informed the social media throng that Claude was indeed tasked with cleaning up the unwanted crypto miner software. “I only had to delete 1 file manually because Claude had an access issue, but it was very effective,” the Redditor said. After that, a Malwarebytes scan was run to check to see if the AI coding agent-driven clean had really been successful.

articles.title: A visit to Samsung’s massive new semiconductor hub
articles.text:
A visit to Samsung’s massive new semiconductor hub
At the world’s biggest chipmaking complex, Samsung is building the fabs it needs for the AI memory boom.
Generative AI models run on powerful chips known as GPUs, which depend on stacks of specialized memory chips packaged with the processor. To meet growing demand for memory, Samsung is building a massive new semiconductor manufacturing complex in Pyeongtaek, South Korea. Three fabs already operate around the clock, and a fourth is coming online. Construction of a fifth was halted during a drop in demand for memory chips in 2024 but restarted when the AI boom sent demand soaring.
It’s just before noon on a Monday, and construction workers are pouring out of Samsung’s fabs in Pyeongtaek, a farming city south of Seoul where rice paddies abut a sprawling chipmaking complex. Thousands of workers, dressed head to toe in black with sky-blue vests, take off helmets bearing their names and fab numbers.
They walk to lunch, sweaty and flushed, in chunky sneakers capped with yellow rubber toe guards. Some hop on scooters or motorcycles to get around the campus, which covers an area about the size of New York City’s Central Park. They’ll dine at buffets, diners, and beef stew joints, walking past banners advertising short-term leases for studio apartments. Some stop by real estate offices to inquire, stepping up to the same counters where Samsung’s salaried engineers buy new homes.
In front of the fourth fab, I meet Choi Hye-rin, a 35-year-old safety officer, as she wipes her forehead with a handkerchief. At dawn, she boarded one of the shuttle buses that ferry workers in from Songtan, an older, scrappier district. She oversees the safety of a crew responsible for building cable ducts. She writes reports, inspects equipment, and checks the chemicals the workers handle. She’s one of hundreds of women working on site, many employed as spotters who walk ahead of heavy equipment.
Safety is a big deal here. After lunch, construction picks right back up. Excavators move past rust-red steel structures rising high under tower cranes. Banners that hang from the highest girders read, “Even if the work runs late, don’t rush.” A giant LED scoreboard announces the winners of a contest for writing a poem about safety. Helmets stickered with a pledge, “I will not work if it’s not safe,” perch atop lockers. The finished fabs glisten from across the street.
Along with the cautionary messages, there’s a sense of urgency in the air. Samsung predicts that demand for memory chips will continue to surge through 2028. And for years the company watched its domestic rival SK Hynix pull ahead in the global market for the high-bandwidth models that power Nvidia’s AI accelerators. (Meanwhile, the Taiwanese chipmaker TSMC has dominated the foundry business, manufacturing chips that other companies design.) The Pyeongtaek build-out is Samsung’s attempt to reclaim its lead on memory chips.
Although the heat can be brutal and the work zones are crowded, Hye-rin has no plans to leave. “The rate here is higher than other construction sites, and the work is relatively easy,” she says. She gets paid 140,000 won ($97) a day and expects the boom to keep her busy for some time: “You just keep coming back.”

articles.title: Inovia secures $200-million USD first close for sixth early-stage VC fund
articles.text:
Inovia Capital has completed a $200-million USD ($282-million CAD) first close of its sixth early-stage venture capital (VC) fund.
The multi-stage, Montréal-based technology investor announced the news today in a LinkedIn post. Returning Inovia limited partners (LPs) like the Business Development Bank of Canada, La Caisse de dépôt et placement du Québec, Canadian Imperial Bank of Commerce, Fondaction, Fonds de solidarité FTQ, Investissement Québec, and Teralys Capital supported the first close.
The first close brings Inovia more than halfway to its $325-million USD Fund VI target.
As BetaKit has previously reported, the strategy and size of Fund VI is expected to be “very similar” to its $325-million USD predecessor. It took Inovia six months to reach this $200-million USD mark, which puts the firm more than halfway toward its $325-million USD target for its latest fund, which it hopes to hit by the first quarter of 2027.
Inovia partner Karamdeep Nijjar told BetaKit over email that Fund VI will focus on AI-native startups and emerging frontier technologies across cybersecurity, infrastructure, developer operations, energy, compute, robotics, and quantum.
He said Fund VI is the investment firm’s “first completely AI-native fund where every business from day one is using AI in some way to change the world.”
Nijjar credited Inovia’s progress amid a tough fundraising market to the trust it has built among its LPs “over many years,” and the strength of its platform, which spans discovery, VC, and growth equity.
He also singled out the performance of Inovia’s fifth venture fund, which he claimed has posted top-quartile performance relative to Cambridge Associates and Carta benchmarks thanks to its investments in fast-growing startups like Cohere, Flare, Gaia, and Spellbook, among others.
RELATED: Inovia promotes Mia Morisset to partner on growth team
Inovia aims to make 15 to 20 core investments out of Fund VI in tech startups from seed to Series A across North America and Europe. Those efforts will be overseen by six partners: Nijjar, Magaly Charbonneau, Shawn Abbott, Kory Jeffrey, Taha Mubashir, and Steve Woods (Jeffrey and Mubashir were promoted to the position last year).
Inovia plans to source opportunities for Fund VI from its Discovery Program for emerging managers, a fund-of-funds initiative it launched a few years ago with a $25-million USD first fund. It is building the next version of that platform with Northleaf Capital Partners. Nijjar declined to share any more details on those plans at this time.
This latest milestone comes a few months after Inovia promoted Mia Morrisset to partner on its growth equity team, which has raised $365 million USD of a planned $450 million for its third such fund. That fund picks up where its VC team stops. These investment vehicles come in addition to a $100-million USD Venture Scientist Fund that Inovia revealed it is co-launching with Québec AI research institute Mila back in early 2026.
This first close of Fund VI brings Inovia’s total assets under management to $2.7 billion USD.
Feature image courtesy Inovia Capital. Photo by Eva Blue.

articles.title: Spotify se pone serio contra las cuentas compartidas y ahora exige esta verificación
articles.text:
Spotify comenzó a implementar una medida que busca acabar con las cuentas compartidas. Siguiendo la tendencia de Netflix y otras empresas, el servicio de música en streaming activó un sistema de verificación para limitar el uso indebido del plan Premium Familiar. Ahora los usuarios tendrán que validar su cuenta mediante un código QR, pero no es tan sencillo como pensabas.
Al igual que otras suscripciones, el plan Premium Familiar de Spotify exige que todos los miembros vivan en el mismo domicilio. Si bien este ayuda a reducir costes al no pagar membresías individuales, muchos lo aprovechan para compartir con los amigos que viven lejos. Los usuarios sacaban ventaja de que Spotify no tenía un método confiable para confirmar que vivías en el mismo domicilio que el responsable de la cuenta familiar, aunque eso terminó hoy.
Algunos usuarios reportan en Reddit que recibieron una notificación en la que se les pide verificar que viven con la persona administradora a través de un código QR. Para evitar los intentos de eludirlo, Spotify cambia el código a los pocos segundos de forma aleatoria, lo que impide capturar pantalla y compartirlo con un tercero para que lo verifique.
Según explica la compañía en su web de soporte, la persona que administra el plan familiar debe abrir el código QR desde la aplicación móvil. Para ello, basta con acceder al perfil y las opciones de gestión de Premium, donde se mostrará el código que tendrá que compartir con el miembro de la familia que requiere la verificación. Este último podrá escanearlo usando la cámara del móvil y el sistema lo registrará como usuario confirmado.
Si no verificas tu cuenta, te quedarás sin Spotify por un año
Debido a que se trata de un plan familiar, es lógico pensar que ambos están en el mismo lugar cuando se realiza la verificación. Los códigos caducan a los pocos segundos, por lo que es difícil enviar la captura por WhatsApp u otro cliente de mensajería. Lo peor de todo es que los usuarios que reciben la notificación solo tienen 7 días para validar la membresía, de lo contrario, no podrán unirse a otro plan familiar o Duo durante los siguientes 12 meses.
La buena noticia para aquellos que comparten la cuenta es que el sistema de verificación por códigos QR de Spotify no es infalible. Algunos usuarios ya consiguieron saltárselo a través de una videollamada, donde es posible escanear el código si la otra persona coloca el móvil frente a la cámara. Es probable que esto cambie y que la compañía implemente medidas adicionales para evitar que el plan Premium Familiar pueda compartirse con terceros.
De momento, los códigos QR se están probando en un número limitado de usuarios. Para verificarse, es necesario que ambos tengan la aplicación móvil actualizada a la última versión. Spotify no confirmó cuándo se desplegará al resto de usuarios, aunque la información ya está en la web de soporte de España, México y otros países de América Latina.

articles.title: Some Google Home Speakers caught downloading hundreds of gigs of data
articles.text:
Some Google Home Speaker owners are currently experiencing an issue in which hundreds of gigabytes of data are being continuously downloaded to their device in the background. The bug, reported by 9to5Google and several Reddit users over the last week, may be caused by the speakers failing to correctly download and install a firmware update, with one Redditor finding that his device was consuming more than 200GB per day.
Some Google Home Speakers caught downloading hundreds of gigs of data
The issue might be tied to failed attempts to install a firmware update.
Thankfully, Google is aware of the issue. In a statement to 9to5Google, the company said that “a fix is already rolling out that should address this for users.” Most of the reports are tied specifically to the new Google Home Speaker model, but it isn’t clear how widespread the issue is. We’ve reached out to Google to request more information about the cause and confirm impacted devices.
My colleague Tom Warren confirmed that his own speaker is unaffected, and 9to5Google reports another Home Speaker in a different household downloaded just 2GB in the past month, compared to to 132GB used by an impacted device over the same period. A big concern for anyone with a limited data plan here is that the bug could quickly eat through the allotted limit, and they wouldn’t know unless they regularly check to see how much data their devices are using.

articles.title: Training AIs to Solve CAPTCHAs - Schneier on Security
articles.text:
Training AIs to Solve CAPTCHAs
Interesting research:
Abstract: Vision-language models (VLMs) can solve visual CAPTCHAs without task-specific training, but the agents built on them approach every challenge from scratch. For such an agent, the hundredth instance of a familiar puzzle costs as much time and compute as the first. Specialized detectors invert the trade-off, answering in milliseconds but only for categories they were trained on. Neither improves with exposure. We study what changes when a solver improves with use. Our system pairs a fine-tuned YOLOv8 detector with an open-weight VLM behind a confidence-based router, and runs entirely from screenshots and operating-system input events, with no browser automation or DOM access. It reaches 85.4% overall and 84.2% macro accuracy across 16 classes, exceeding either component alone. Every answer VLM produces also serves as a training label, so the detector absorbs categories it was never trained for, typically after one or two encounters and without human annotation. The same loop also repairs it. A CAPTCHA operator can perturb images against the publicly released detector and drive its accuracy to 0%, but the perturbations leave VLM untouched, and its labels let the detector recover. Under a year-long simulated arms race in which the CAPTCHA operator re-crafts its perturbations each month, the solver recovers every round, and a cheap ~70%-accurate open-weight teacher hardens it as effectively as a perfect oracle. Visual CAPTCHA defenses that assume a failing bot stays failing therefore understate how quickly an adaptive solver returns.
Clive Robinson • October 19, 2026 9:49 AM

Training a Current LLM AI to solve a CAPTCHA should be well within it’s capabilities…

articles.title: 35 Jahre altes Microsoft-Programm verliert Support – diese Gratis-Alternativen ersetzen es
articles.text:
35 Jahre altes Microsoft-Programm verliert Support – diese Gratis-Alternativen ersetzen es
Die erste Version von Microsoft Publisher erschien bereits 1991 für Windows 3.0, also vor rund 35 Jahren. Mitte Oktober hat Microsoft den Support für seine Desktop-Publishing-Software jetzt endgültig eingestellt. Der Konzern rät Nutzenden jetzt, ihre alten pub-Dokumente als PDF zu konservieren oder sie ins docx-Format umzuwandeln.
Alte Daten richtig sichern
Allerdings sind das nicht die einzigen und vielleicht auch nicht die besten Möglichkeiten für alle, die auf der Basis von pub-Vorlagen noch regelmäßig etwa Druckpublikationen wie Plakate oder Kalender erstellen oder E-Mail-Newsletter herausgeben. Das erklärt die Document Foundation, die hinter der freien und kostenlosen Bürosoftware-Suite LibreOffice steht.
Denn bei der Konvertierung in das docx-Format könne die Formatierung komplexer Dateien zerschossen werden. Deshalb haben die LibreOffice-Entwickler das pub-Format zurückentwickelt, so dass es jetzt möglich ist, pub-Dateien mit LibreOffice Draw zu öffnen, im offenen OpenDocument-Format (ODF) zu speichern und zu bearbeiten.
Einfaches oder aufwendiges Layout?
Zwar stoße auch LibreOffice Draw beim Layouten irgendwann an seine Grenzen, weil es sich dabei um ein Grafikprogramm und nicht um eine Desktop-Publishing-Anwendung handelt. Das Bearbeiten kleiner, mehrseitiger Dokumente wie Newsletter oder einseitiger Dokumente jeden Formats sei aber problemlos möglich.
Als Open-Source-Alternative für aufwendigere Layouts empfiehlt die Document Foundation das freie und kostenlose Desktop-Publishing-Programm Scribus, das wie LibreOffice unter anderem für Windows, macOS und Linux verfügbar ist, allerdings kein Standard-Dateiformat verwendet.

articles.title: Volkswagen s’est allié à Xpeng pour sauver ses ventes de voitures électriques en Chine, ça commence mal
articles.text:
Volkswagen a longtemps été l’un des leaders sur le marché automobile chinois, mais depuis 2022, la marque allemande perd du terrain face à des groupes locaux comme BYD ou Geely. Si le constructeur résiste encore sur le marché des véhicules thermiques, il a pour le moment manqué le virage de l’électrification en Chine. Pour tenter de rattraper son retard technologique (notamment logiciel), le groupe allemand a noué en 2023 une alliance inattendue avec le constructeur chinois Xpeng.
Cet accord devait être un « raccourci » industriel permettant de développer des voitures pensées pour le marché chinois, à la vitesse des marques chinoises. Trois ans plus tard, le premier fruit de cette union est arrivé dans les concessions : le Volkswagen ID. UNYX 08. Et selon une analyse de Reuters ce 20 octobre 2026, le succès n’est pas au rendez-vous.
L’ID. UNYX 08 a calé au démarrage
Entre son lancement en avril et le mois d’août 2026, Volkswagen n’a écoulé en moyenne que 267 exemplaires de l’ID. UNYX 08 par mois. On est loin des 3 622 ventes mensuelles prévues dans les documents de planification initiaux du constructeur que Reuters mentionne. Alors que d’autres marques chinoises enregistrent des dizaines de milliers de précommandes en quelques minutes lors de leur présentation, ce résultat fait tache.
Comment expliquer un tel flop pour un modèle pourtant développé en un temps record (18 mois) grâce à l’architecture électrique de Xpeng ? Plusieurs éléments peuvent expliquer ce résultat décevant : le prix, le réseau de distribution et un manque de différenciation.
L’ID. UNYX 08 a été lancé à un tarif d’environ 30 000 euros. Le problème, c’est qu’à ce prix-là, la concurrence chinoise propose souvent mieux. Le Xiaomi YU7 propose une bien meilleure dotation y compris technologique, tandis que le Zeekr 7X offre des vitesses de recharge supérieures. Les chiffres parlent d’eux-mêmes : Xiaomi a vendu 57 000 YU7 sur la même période, contre à peine 1 300 pour le SUV germano-chinois.
Au lieu d’utiliser son immense réseau de 3 000 concessionnaires historiques (gérés avec SAIC et FAW), Volkswagen a tenté de vendre l’UNYX via une nouvelle entité dédiée aux électriques (Volkswagen Anhui) qui ne compte que 166 points de vente. Une grande partie des consommateurs n’a même pas eu connaissance de l’existence du véhicule. Il faut dire que 542 nouveaux modèles ont été lancés sur le marché chinois entre janvier et mai 2026. Dans un tel contexte, un lancement doit être particulièrement soigné pour ne pas passer inaperçu.
Comme le relève un analyste interrogé par Reuters, l’un des handicaps de ce modèle est son manque d’originalité. En s’appuyant trop ouvertement sur les lignes des modèles Xpeng existants, Volkswagen a accouché d’un véhicule dont le style paraissait déjà daté au moment même de sa présentation au salon de Pékin. Souhaitons que la berline ID. UNYX 09 rencontre davantage son public.
Bilan prématuré ou échec prévisible ?
Ce démarrage raté oblige déjà Volkswagen à ajuster sa stratégie. La marque a été contrainte de proposer des remises de 17 % sur l’UNYX 08 ces dernières semaines. Dans un mémo interne récent, Ralf Brandstaetter, le patron de VW en Chine, demande d’aligner en urgence les capacités de production sur les « réalités du marché ».
Faut-il pour autant condamner l’alliance Volkswagen-Xpeng ? Il est sans doute trop tôt. Le premier modèle issu d’une alliance est souvent un galop d’essai. Les partenaires doivent apprendre à travailler ensemble pour proposer un véhicule adapté au marché chinois. Rien n’indique qu’en s’associant à BYD ou Leapmotor, Volkswagen aurait mieux réussi.
Le prochain vrai test pour l’alliance aura lieu ce mois-ci, avec le lancement attendu de la berline ID. UNYX 09. Si ce second modèle trébuche à son tour, cela pourrait devenir compliqué pour cette alliance qui pourrait se défaire aussi vite qu’elle a été signée. C’est cela aussi, le rythme chinois. En attendant, Volkswagen n’a pas seulement misé sur ce seul partenariat, le constructeur allemand a également d’autres gammes de produits à proposer sur le marché chinois. Tout n’est pas perdu.

articles.title: Disrupt Africa, Touch Inspiration launch accelerator to help non-technical founders build and launch apps - Disrupt Africa
articles.text:
Disrupt Africa has partnered with Kenya-based digital product and technology company Touch Inspiration to launch Disrupt Launchpad, an app development accelerator that helps non-technical founders turn their ideas into working applications and bring them to market.
Founded in 2014, Disrupt Africa is the leading news platform dedicated to the African tech startup ecosystem, and a producer of research publications and podcasts.
Touch Inspiration was founded in 2017 and helps entrepreneurs and businesses turn their ideas into working digital products. The company specialises in developing web and mobile applications, AI-powered solutions and business platforms, taking products from defined requirements through development and launch.
The two organisations have joined forces to launch Disrupt Launchpad, a programme designed for entrepreneurs who have a clear app idea but lack the technical skills, team or resources to bring it to life. Through Touch Inspiration, founders can get their apps professionally built and launched at startup-friendly rates, while Disrupt Africa helps put those products in front of a wider audience of potential users, customers and investors.
“We meet so many people who are inspired to create something, but don’t know how to bring it to life. What makes this partnership with Disrupt Africa so exciting is that we get to help those people build their apps and, just as importantly, get them in front of the people who will actually use them. It’s one thing to have a great idea, but seeing it come to life and reach the market is where the real value is realised,” said Robert M., founder of Touch Inspiration.
“The whole point of Disrupt Africa has always been to make entrepreneurship accessible to everyone, and with this partnership with Robert M. and the amazing team at Touch Inspiration we’re going right in at the start. Funding is important, networking is key, but being able to build your great idea in the first place is absolutely essential,” said Tom Jackson, co-founder of Disrupt Africa. “This programme will help you build, and launch, and put you in a strong position to turn it into a success.”
Aspiring entrepreneurs and existing startups with clear app ideas are invited to apply through Disrupt Launchpad. The programme offers startup-friendly development rates, while selected ventures may even qualify for an equity-based partnership, reducing the upfront cost of getting their applications built.

articles.title: Startup news and updates: daily roundup (October 19, 2026)
articles.text:
Startup news and updates: daily roundup (October 19, 2026)
YourStory presents the daily news roundup from the Indian startup ecosystem and beyond. Here's the roundup for Monday, October 19, 2026.
From India’s artificial intelligence (AI) opportunity to how a Bengaluru hospital is paying doctors for recovery, not procedures, here are the latest developments across sectors.
Featured Stories
India's next tech edge according to CTOs
India’s technology industry has long relied on talent, cost efficiency and scale. But as artificial intelligence makes advanced tools more accessible, these advantages alone may no longer be enough to differentiate companies.
The next edge, according to technology leaders at TechSparks 2026, will come from how effectively companies use AI to solve specific problems, understand customers and build products that are difficult to replicate.
Read more
Funding News
Even Healthcare raises $50M in Series B round
Bengaluru-based managed care company Even Healthcare has raised $50 million in a Series B round led by existing investor Khosla Ventures. Alpha Wave also participated in the round.
According to the company, the round values it at three times its valuation 18 months ago and brings its total funding to more than $120 million.
The money will go towards five new Even hospitals in Bengaluru over the next six months, beginning with Indiranagar. The company runs two hospitals in the city at present.
The Pant Project bags Rs 109 Cr to accelerate retail expansion
The Pant Project, a premium menswear label specialising in trousers and other bottomwear, has raised Rs 109 crore in a Series B funding round led by Mirae Asset Venture Investments.
Existing investor Sorin Investments also participated, alongside family offices and angel investors including Anisha Saraf, B&K Securities, MGA Ventures and B2V Ventures. The company has also secured venture debt from Alteria Capital, with IndigoEdge advising on the equity transaction.
Founded by brothers Dhruv and Udit Toshniwal, The Pant Project began as a digital-first business focused on fit, fabric performance and comfort for Indian men. Its products include Malai Pants and Inklock No Fade Black Jeans, and it sells through its website, Myntra, Amazon and physical stores.
Other News
AngelBot AI launches TeamSync to secure enterprise knowledge with AI-powered search
AngelBot AI has launched TeamSync, an AI-native platform designed to help enterprises securely search, manage and extract insights from fragmented documents and information repositories.
The platform combines natural-language document interaction, semantic search and permissions-aware AI, with citations and audit trails to support reliable information access. Its capabilities also include metadata extraction, electronic signatures, contract lifecycle management and eDiscovery.
Targeting mid-sized and large enterprises across regulated and document-intensive sectors, TeamSync offers subscription-based software, platform licensing and implementation services. The launch builds on AngelBot AI’s document management work, including IMIR, which has received recognition from the Indian Air Force.
VETO launches sports carnival, offers 300+ hours of subscription-free live sports
VETO, India’s subscription-free OTT platform, has launched the VETO Sports Carnival, offering more than 300 hours of live sports streaming across cricket, football, weightlifting and tennis during October and November.
The line-up includes an international ODI tri-series, Test matches, the IWF World Senior Championships, SAFF Championship, Billie Jean King Cup Play-offs and Davis Cup Finals.
The initiative expands VETO’s live sports portfolio as it seeks to make international sporting events accessible to Indian audiences without a subscription fee. The platform also offers 60+ live TV channels across 12 languages and more than 10 content genres.
Yes Madam revenue hits Rs 402 Cr annualised run rate, grows 3.9x in two years
At-home beauty and wellness platform Yes Madam has reported a 3.9-fold increase in revenue and 3.5-fold growth in Net Transaction Value (NTV) between Q2 FY25 and Q2 FY27. The company’s annualised revenue run rate reached Rs 402 crore, while its NTV run rate stood at Rs 836 crore.
In Q2 FY27, revenue rose 69% year-on-year to Rs 79.4 crore, while NTV grew 75% to Rs 165.8 crore.
Founded in 2016, Yes Madam operates across more than 55 cities with a network of 10,000-plus service professionals. The company plans to expand services, strengthen its network and invest in technology.
So/Facet raises Rs 10 Cr seed funding led by Sauce to build lab-grown diamond jewellery brand
So/Facet, a premium lab-grown diamond jewellery brand founded by former Unilever executives Aarushi Agrawal Naulakha and Abhishek Naulakha, has raised Rs10 crore in a seed funding round led by Sauce.
The company will use the capital for brand building, design, technology, hiring and an omnichannel retail expansion. Set to launch online in November 2026, So/Facet plans to open more than 30 premium stores over three years.
The brand aims to position lab-grown diamonds as expressions of personal style rather than jewellery reserved for traditional milestones. Its six launch collections feature IGI-certified diamonds and contemporary, in-house designs.
Guttify targets Tier II markets in three states, eyes 5x growth in annual recurring revenue
Gut-health startup Guttify plans to expand into select Tier II markets across Uttar Pradesh, Rajasthan and Punjab through pilot initiatives in FY27, targeting fivefold growth in annual recurring revenue (ARR).
The company has served over 30,000 consumers and reported 67% quarter-on-quarter growth. Its Rs 399 DIY Gut Scan Kit sold approximately 15,000 units between January and August 2026, with around half of buyers subsequently purchasing other products.
Guttify plans to expand its portfolio with products including Poopie, a fibre-based constipation-support product, and RISE, a morning greens blend, while strengthening personalised recommendations, consumer education and expert guidance.
As You Asked raises Rs 45 lakh pre-seed funding to expand children’s nutrition products
As You Asked, a nutrition startup focused on children aged 2–12, has raised Rs 45 lakh in an equity-funded pre-seed round backed by ISB D-Labs and angel investors. The company will use the funds to support its market launch, product development, manufacturing and distribution.
Its planned portfolio includes daily nutrition powders, hydration mixes and micronutrient gummies without added sugars. The startup has engaged more than 100 parents, conducted over 200 child taste tests and run an early pilot involving 200-plus customers to inform its product development. It aims to make everyday nutrition simpler, accessible and easier for families to incorporate into daily routines.

articles.title: Revolut está caído: el servicio falla en varios países y los usuarios no pueden acceder a sus cuentas
articles.text:
Revolut, uno de los principales neobancos de Europa, está sufriendo una interrupción de su servicio que ha dejado a muchos clientes sin poder abrir la app o acceder a sus cuentas. Varios usuarios han señalado en redes sociales que la plataforma está caída. Además, la empresa ha reconocido el fallo y afirma que está trabajando en una solución.
Qué ocurre. Al abrir la app de Revolut, los clientes reciben un mensaje de error que dice que algo ha salido mal y les pide que lo intenten más tarde. Nosotros mismos hemos podido comprobarlo al querer acceder a la aplicación y, si bien en un primer momento parece que no ocurre nada, a los pocos segundos aparece este mensaje de error, dando a entender que hay un problema en el servicio e impidiéndonos operar normalmente.
Hay quejas de fallos en el servicio en varios países, entre ellos España, Reino Unido y Francia, aunque de momento no está claro si todos los usuarios están afectados. A través de este enlace puedes ver qué servicios están fallando ahora mismo.
Según cuenta el medio The Independent, el problema tendría que ver con un fallo en los servicios de Google Cloud, concretamente en uno de sus servidores europeos situado en Londres.
UN VISTAZO A...
Qué ha dicho Revolut. La empresa ha reconocido el problema en la red social X, diciendo que estaba “experimentando una interrupción del servicio que afecta a múltiples funciones, lo que puede provocar que algunos servicios no estén accesibles”, y que su equipo de ingeniería estaba trabajando para restablecer el servicio completo. Hasta el momento, Revolut no ha dado un plazo para la solución ni ha explicado qué está causando el fallo.
Sin poder pagar. Según comparte The Independent, algunos usuarios afirman que sus tarjetas también han dejado de funcionar, lo que les está impidiendo pagar en las tiendas. Esto sugiere que el problema podría ir más allá de la propia app, aunque Revolut no lo ha confirmado.
Qué puedes hacer por ahora. Dado que el fallo parece estar en el lado de Revolut, lo único que podemos hacer ahora es esperar a que Revolut confirme que el problema está solucionado. En caso de que necesites pagar algo urgente, la opción más segura es contar con otra tarjeta o pagar en efectivo, que eso de momento nunca falla.
Por nuestra parte, actualizaremos este artículo en cuanto Revolut ofrezca más detalles o se reestablezca el servicio.

articles.title: Samsung préparerait une refonte majeure de One UI qui pourrait tout changer
articles.text:
Pour rappel, One UI, l’interface de Samsung, a été lancée en 2018. One UI 9, la dernière version de cette interface, a quant à elle été déployée en septembre 2026. Il faut dire que depuis sa sortie, One UI n’a jamais connu de grands chamboulements : les nouveautés se sont limitées à quelques retouches annuelles et à quelques nouvelles fonctionnalités IA. Les utilisateurs attendent donc une refonte de l’interface, alors que Google et Apple ont récemment mis à jour la leur. Bonne nouvelle, il semble que cela soit dans les tuyaux de Samsung.
Une refonte majeure de One UI
Sur le réseau social X, Ice Universe, un leaker souvent bien informé, annonce : « One UI 10 apportera des changements significatifs, d’une nature sans précédent ». Il précise par ailleurs que l’information provient d’une « source indépendante ». Sur le réseau social chinois Weibo, le leaker précise que toute l’équipe logicielle de Samsung travaille sur cette nouvelle version de l’interface One UI et que One UI 9.5 sera « la dernière génération d’interface traditionnelle ». Le Galaxy Z Fold 9 serait le premier téléphone à bénéficier de One UI 10, basé sur Android 18.
De son côté, le média SamMobile rapporte que le Z Flip 9 pourrait aussi en bénéficier et que la date de lancement se situerait au milieu de l’année 2027 ou au début de 2028. La gamme des Galaxy S27 ne devrait donc pas l’intégrer. En revanche, la gamme des Galaxy S28, oui.
Que peut-on attendre de la refonte de One UI ?
Le site spécialisé Nokia Power User, qui assure s’être entretenu avec un salarié des équipes logicielles de Samsung, annonce l’abandon des icônes d’applications traditionnelles et des grilles statiques. Les applications seraient ainsi réunies au même endroit, et les utilisateurs n’auraient plus à jongler entre plusieurs d’entre elles isolées. L’objectif de Samsung : réduire au maximum le nombre de clics sur le téléphone.
Sans grande surprise, Samsung travaillerait aussi à davantage unifier son écosystème, avec notamment un passage plus simple du téléphone à une tablette ou une montre de la firme. Côté intelligence artificielle, les applications de base resteraient gratuites, tandis que celles qui demandent davantage de calculs et d’intégration d’applications tierces deviendraient payantes.
Enfin, il reste à connaître le nom de cette nouvelle interface. Celle-ci pourrait tout simplement s’appeler One UI 10 ou adopter un nouveau nom, les changements étant majeurs. Le leaker Phonefuturist a d’ailleurs rapporté que la nouvelle version de One UI pourrait être baptisée « Galaxy OS ». Il reste maintenant à attendre une communication officielle de Samsung pour en avoir le cœur net.

articles.title: Most AI incident tools still leave a key decision to humans
articles.text:
Most AI incident tools still leave a key decision to humans
An AI SRE agent can help troubleshoot an incident. But can you trust it to decide on its own when something needs attention?
Most teams treat agent autonomy as a yes or no question. For incident response, it is a progression with three phases, and many agents in production sit earlier on it than the teams running them realize. Most AI SRE tools still stop short of the final phase.
On Thursday, October 22, The New Stack hosts a live webinar with Raaz Dwivedi, co-founder and CTO of Traversal and an assistant professor at Cornell Tech. His team applies causal AI and agentic reasoning to production incidents. He will walk through where the industry sits on that progression and what it takes to move up.
You have successfully registered for the webinar.
The three phases of agent autonomy
Invoked: copilots, chat interfaces, and CLIs that wait for an on-call engineer to open them and ask a question mid-incident.
Background: scheduled jobs, alert rules, and triggers that fire on conditions someone predicted in advance.
Proactive: agents that decide for themselves when an incident needs attention, without waiting to be invoked or scheduled.
The first two phases share a limit. Each depends on a person noticing that something is wrong, or on someone predicting the right condition ahead of time. Proactive agents remove that dependency.
What it takes to trust an AI SRE agent
Moving to the third phase raises a trust question. An agent that waits to be asked can be wrong without much consequence, because an engineer reviews the answer. An agent that decides when to engage also has to judge when to stay quiet. Dwivedi will cover what separates an agent that responds from one that acts on its own, why many AI SRE tools stall in the first two phases, and what has to be true before a team lets an agent make that call.
What changes once agents act on their own
Dwivedi will also discuss where the shift is already happening, drawing on Traversal Workers, agents that already operate at the proactive end of the progression. He will explore what changes for engineering teams once the agent in their stack stops waiting to be asked.
The session closes with live Q&A, so you can ask him your questions directly.
Join us on Thursday, October 22, 2026 at 1 p.m. Eastern / 10 a.m. Pacific, to learn where your team stands in the progression and what it would take to move up. Register today.

articles.title: Scandale des objets volés lors des pillages revendus en ligne : Leboncoin, Vinted et eBay expliquent leur stratégie
articles.text:
Des objets volés lors des pillages du 17 octobre ont été remis en vente sur Vinted et Leboncoin dans les heures suivantes. Le gouvernement réunit les plateformes, qui présentent leurs dispositifs de modération.
La revente d'objets volés lors des pillages du 17 octobre 2026, qui auraient touché plus de 2 000 commerces selon une estimation de CCI France, n'a pas traîné puisque dès le soir même, des annonces suspectes s'affichaient sur Vinted et Leboncoin. Produits de beauté bradés, discussions déplacées sur Snapchat, acheteurs qui réclament leur part sans se cacher : un petit marché parallèle s'est monté en quelques heures. Sommées de s'expliquer, les plateformes mettent en avant leurs contrôles et leurs modérateurs, tandis que le gouvernement promet que les revendeurs ne s'en tireront pas à si bon compte.
Des objets volés lors des pillages du 17 octobre bradés en ligne, l'État hausse le ton
Sur les captures d'écran partagées depuis les débordements qui ont émaillé les manifestations contre la vie chère, l'inventaire est parfois comparable à un rayon de grand magasin. Des vêtements, maquillage et parfums y étaient proposés à prix sacrifiés sur Vinted ou Leboncoin, a notamment rapporté franceinfo, et certaines annonces affichaient sans complexe la date du 17 octobre. L'une vantait ainsi du « maquillage du 17 octobre pas cher », tandis qu'un internaute dénonçait sur les réseaux sociaux une offre de « Pull volé pendant la manif ». Prudence toutefois, car rien ne prouve que chaque annonce relayée sur les réseaux concerne réellement des objets pillés.
Pour boucler la transaction loin des modérateurs, de nombreux vendeurs ont invité à poursuivre la discussion sur Snapchat. Et l'offre ne manquait pas de preneurs ce week-end. Des acheteurs ont publié leurs propres annonces pour solliciter directement les pillards. Lundi, ces annonces s'étaient volatilisées, sans qu'on sache si Vinted ou leurs auteurs avaient fait le ménage. La plateforme assure que ses équipes ont « agi immédiatement pour identifier et supprimer les annonces susceptibles de concerner des biens volés », au nom d'une « tolérance zéro ». Les comptes fautifs risquent jusqu'au « bannissement définitif ».
L'affaire est remontée jusqu'au gouvernement. Lundi après-midi, Anne Le Hénanff, ministre déléguée chargée de l'IA et du Numérique, a annoncé réunir les plateformes concernées avec Serge Papin, ministre des PME et du Commerce, en présence de représentants des ministères de l'Intérieur et de la Justice. « De tels comportements ne resteront pas impunis. Nous ne laisserons pas passer », prévient-elle. Elle exige que les annonces soient retirées « sans délai », et que les plateformes collaborent « étroitement » avec l'État pour que les revendeurs soient poursuivis. En fin de journée, la ministre est allée plus loin en annonçant réunir dès mardi matin les représentants des principales plateformes de réseaux sociaux, afin de « faire le point sur la situation et définir ensemble les actions à engager ». Dans la journée, Jordan Bardella et Gabriel Attal avaient eux aussi plaidé pour une coopération accrue entre l'État et les sites de revente.
Contrôles automatisés et modérateurs, ce qui est mis en place par les plateformes
Contacté par Clubic, Leboncoin a livré la réponse la plus détaillée, en rappelant que la lutte contre les activités illicites fait partie de ses « priorités absolues ». Selon la plateforme, « 100 % des annonces déposées sur leboncoin font l'objet de contrôles automatisés avant leur mise en ligne ». Autrement dit, aucune annonce n'apparaît sans être d'abord passée au crible par une machine. Des modérateurs prennent ensuite le relais pour examiner les signalements, que chacun peut faire depuis le site ou l'application. Ceux qui sont conformes aux exigences légales sont traités « dans un délai maximum de 48 heures ». À la clé, l'annonce peut être supprimée, voire le compte bloqué.
Personne n'ose ou ne peut encore donner de chiffres détaillés. Leboncoin dit ne pas disposer « de données consolidées permettant d'établir une hausse du nombre d'annonces litigieuses ou une évolution des prix » liée aux 17 et 18 octobre, et eBay « n'est pas en mesure de confirmer une hausse ». Le site américain met en avant ses « outils technologiques », épaulés par des contrôles manuels, ainsi qu'une équipe spécialisée et un portail réservé aux forces de l'ordre. Il promet un retrait immédiat dès que la police confirme un vol, avec des sanctions qui peuvent aller jusqu'à la suspension définitive du compte.
Aucune des trois plateformes ne donne encore trop de détails. Toutes promettent en revanche de coopérer avec les autorités, Leboncoin évoquant même un service dédié aux réquisitions judiciaires et administratives. Pour les internautes, il est toujours bon de savoir que la revente d'objets volés constitue un recel, un délit passible de cinq ans de prison et de 375 000 euros d'amende. Un parfum neuf, encore emballé, cédé à prix cassé ces jours-ci mérite plutôt un signalement qu'un clic sur « acheter ».

articles.title: Spectrum costs squeeze African telecom investment and growth
articles.text:
Africa’s mobile networks have expanded significantly over the past decade, bringing coverage to more people. But wider coverage has not translated into widespread internet use or network quality on par with other regions.
A new report by the GSMA, Spectrum Policy in Africa: Enabling Investment and Empowering Consumers Through Effective Spectrum Pricing, identifies the high cost of accessing radio spectrum—the invisible radio frequencies that carry mobile calls and internet data—as a central bottleneck. African mobile operators pay significantly more for relatively less spectrum, leaving them with limited capacity to expand or improve service quality.
According to GSMA Intelligence, spectrum costs consume 0.82% of mobile operators’ revenue per 100 MHz in Africa, compared with 0.66% in the rest of the world. Meanwhile, African operators hold an average of about 570 MHz of spectrum below 7 GHz, 24% less than the global peer average of approximately 750 MHz.
The imbalance extends beyond price and availability to licence duration. Only nine African countries routinely grant spectrum licences lasting 20 years or more, while licences of 20 years or indefinite duration are standard across Europe, North America and developed Asian markets.
Lowering spectrum fees could free up vital capital for network expansion, but lower fees alone do not guarantee better connectivity. The crucial test for African regulators is whether more affordable access can be tied to measurable improvements in network quality and internet adoption, particularly in underserved communities where initial financial returns remain low.

articles.title: “Il sera doué de conscience” : le Tesla Roadster volant exécutera seul ses acrobaties, jure Elon Musk
articles.text:
“Il sera doué de conscience” : le Tesla Roadster volant exécutera seul ses acrobaties, jure Elon Musk
Deux jours après avoir fait voler son nouveau Roadster par-dessus cinq Tesla, Elon Musk monte encore d'un cran. La sportive électrique enchaînera ses acrobaties toute seule, sur simple demande, et un circuit à looping plus fou que les Hot Wheels attendra ses propriétaires au Texas. Comment ? Mystère total.
Le 15 octobre au soir, sur le site d'essais de SpaceX à McGregor, près de Waco (Texas), Tesla a enfin levé le voile sur la deuxième génération de son Roadster. La voiture avait été exhibée en prototype dès novembre 2017 et promise à l'époque pour 2020. Le spectacle n'a pas déçu : la voiture a gravi une rampe incurvée jusqu'à se retrouver la tête en bas, s'est arrachée du sol grâce à des propulseurs à gaz froid développés avec SpaceX, puis a bondi au-dessus d'une Model 3, d'un Model Y, d'un Cybertruck, d'un Semi et d'un Cybercab.
Samedi 17 octobre, Elon Musk a surenchéri sur X. Le commentateur tech Robert Scoble rappelait qu'au volant du Roadster, on commande surtout un ordinateur, puisque la direction et le freinage sont entièrement électroniques. Le patron de Tesla a acquiescé, puis assuré que la voiture rejouerait ces figures sans personne aux commandes.
True. 
You will be able to ask the Roadster to perform any of the tricks shown autonomously, as it will be sentient. 
Also, we will have a wild looping track (crazier even than Hot Wheels) at our Texas HQ where you can test out your Roadster.
— Elon Musk (@elonmusk) October 17, 2026
Le terme anglais choisi, "sentient", désigne d'ordinaire un être capable de ressentir. Appliqué à une voiture, il relève de la formule choc, que Musk se garde bien de définir.
	
Vous pourrez demander au Roadster d'exécuter de manière autonome n'importe laquelle des figures montrées, car il sera doué de conscience. Nous aurons aussi un circuit à looping complètement fou (encore plus dingue que Hot Wheels) à notre siège du Texas, où vous pourrez tester votre Roadster.
Cascades autonomes et piste à looping : des promesses sans mode d'emploi
Derrière l'effet d'annonce, les zones d'ombre s'accumulent. Musk ne détaille ni la technologie censée orchestrer ces figures sans intervention humaine, ni les garde-fous prévus, ni les conditions dans lesquelles on pourra les déclencher. Même brouillard autour du circuit texan : aucun plan, aucun calendrier, aucune règle d'accès connue.
Tesla Roadster en France : 50 000 euros pour réserver, prix encore inconnu
La gamme compte trois déclinaisons. La Performance, biplace pensée pour la route, abat le 0 à 97 km/h en moins de 1,6 seconde selon Tesla. La Thrust, édition limitée taillée pour le circuit, ajoute des propulseurs arrière et descend sous les 0,9 seconde. La Rocket, monoplace capable de voler, reste réservée aux invités et n'est pas autorisée sur la voie publique.
Les amateurs français peuvent déjà réserver leur Roadster. Pour la Performance, il faut verser 5 000 euros remboursables à la commande, puis 45 000 euros sous dix jours. La Thrust exige 250 000 euros. Le prix de vente reste un secret bien gardé, et Elon Musk vise un lancement de la production en 2028.
